title: Administrator
description:
Administrator

Shrewsbury
37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday
£15.00 per hour
Temporary Maternity Cover 9 months

We are currently recruiting on behalf of a well-established and growing business based in Shrewsbury. Due to a period of maternity leave, they are now looking to appoint an Administrator to support their busy Projects and Operations teams. Whilst this is initially a temporary assignment, there is potential for longer-term opportunities within the business for the right person.

Key Responsibilities:
- Maintaining accurate project files, records, correspondence, and documentation
- Preparing project reports, meeting minutes, and business correspondence
- Updating project trackers, registers, and administrative records
- Collating project documentation, records, and handover information
- Coordinating travel, accommodation, and logistics arrangements
- Managing bookings, amendments, and cancellations as required
- Placing authorised orders for materials, equipment, office supplies, and stationery
- Maintaining purchase records, order confirmations, and delivery information
- Following up with suppliers regarding outstanding orders and deliveries
- Liaising with Finance and Procurement teams to resolve purchasing and invoice queries
- Coordinating meetings, appointments, and project-related activities
- Responding to routine enquiries and supporting communication across departments
- Assisting with wider administrative duties as required

The successful candidate will have previous administrative experience and be highly organised, with excellent attention to detail and strong communication skills. You will be confident using Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook, Word, and Excel, and will ideally have experience of arranging travel or accommodation bookings, processing orders, maintaining accurate records, and liaising with suppliers. The role would suit someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, can manage multiple priorities, and takes pride in providing accurate and efficient administrative support.

The application process:

Our mission is to support our clients in their creation of an equal, diverse and inclusive workforce. We are committed to providing a barrier-free recruitment process, so if you require any reasonable accessibility adjustments within the application process, then please make it known at the earliest opportunity.

We will carefully consider your details and advise you if we're able to progress with your application within 72 working hours. If you do not hear from us within this time your details won t be retained. So, if you're not successful on this occasion, do continue to respond to future roles we advertise. In the meantime, all good wishes and continued success with your search for employment.

About Us

Prince Personnel are an employment agency working on behalf of our client. Whether you re seeking a new permanent position, temporary assignment or contract you ll find us easy to deal with. Located in thriving Telford, we focus on jobs in Shropshire, Staffordshire and North Wales. Prince Personnel specialise in commercial, accounts and finance and technical recruitment. With the best jobs around we are an independent agency working hard for you.

title: Customer Service Administrator
description:
Role Details

Role: Property Manager

Location: Shrewsbury

Salary: £28,000-£31,000

Role Overview

Durrant Talent Solutions is proud to be partnering with a leading national residential managing agent in the search for a Property Manager to join their Shrewsbury team.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Property Manager to take ownership of a residential portfolio, delivering exceptional property management services while building strong relationships with leaseholders, residents, clients and contractors.

The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring developments are managed to the highest professional standards, maintaining compliance, overseeing maintenance and service delivery, and providing an outstanding customer experience across their portfolio.

Role Responsibilities
- Manage a portfolio of residential leasehold developments.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with leaseholders, Resident Management Companies (RMCs), Right to Manage Companies (RTMs) and freeholder clients.
- Prepare and manage annual service charge budgets in conjunction with internal teams.
- Monitor expenditure and ensure developments are managed within approved budgets.
- Arrange, attend and chair site inspections and client meetings as required.
- Instruct, monitor and review contractors to ensure works are completed to the required standard.
- Oversee planned and reactive maintenance across the portfolio.
- Ensure compliance with all relevant health and safety legislation, including fire, asbestos, water hygiene and lift regulations.
- Work closely with internal departments including finance, compliance and customer services.
- Respond promptly and professionally to customer enquiries and resolve issues effectively.
- Ensure accurate property records are maintained and all administration is completed within agreed timescales.

Essential Experience

The successful candidate will have:
- Previous experience managing a residential block management portfolio.
- A good understanding of residential leasehold legislation and property management best practice.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage a varied workload.
- A proactive and customer-focused approach.
- The ability to prioritise tasks and work independently.
- Competent IT skills, including Microsoft Office.
- A full UK driving licence (where required).

Desirable Experience
- TPI qualified or working towards level 3
- Experience using property management software such as Qube, TRAMPS, Propman or similar.

Equal Opportunities Statement

Durrant Talent Solutions is committed to promoting equality, diversity and inclusion throughout the recruitment process. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified individuals regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected under the Equality Act 2010. Selection decisions are based solely on skills, experience, qualifications and suitability for the role.

Due to the high volume of applications received, we may only be able to contact candidates who are shortlisted. If you do not hear from us within 7 days of submitting your application, please assume your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion.

title: Purchase Ledger
description:
About the Business

A fantastic opportunity to join a well-established public sector organisation based in Shrewsbury as a Purchase Ledger Assistant, paying £26,000 - £28,000 per annum. This is a 6-month temp to perm role, giving you a clear route into a permanent position. You'll take real ownership of the purchase ledger and utility accounts, working in a close-knit, supportive finance team where accuracy and good supplier relationships really matter.

Main Duties:

As a Purchase Ledger Assistant, your main duties include:
- Processing invoices and credit notes from suppliers, checking each one against the relevant purchase order and delivery paperwork before it is posted
- Allocating costs to the right budget and nominal codes, applying the correct VAT treatment every time
- Sending invoices to the appropriate budget holders for sign-off, making sure approval limits and financial procedures are followed
- Running the weekly and monthly BACS payment cycles, making sure every supplier is paid correctly and on schedule
- Creating new supplier accounts and keeping existing records up to date, carrying out thorough checks on any bank detail changes to protect against fraud
- Raising sales invoices and recharges to partner organisations and other parties where costs need to be recovered
- Being the go-to contact for suppliers over the phone and by email, resolving their queries quickly and courteously
- Looking into missing, duplicated or disputed invoices and following up on outstanding credit notes
- Reconciling monthly statements from suppliers against the ledger and clearing any differences
- Reviewing gas, electricity and water bills for accuracy, comparing them with meter readings, tariffs and agreed contract rates
- Tracking usage and spend across properties, shared spaces and offices, spotting trends and anything out of the ordinary

Location / Office / Culture

The role is hybrid, based in Shrewsbury, giving you a good balance between time in the office and working from home. You'll join a friendly, collaborative finance team who work closely with colleagues right across the organisation. It's a role with genuine variety, combining day-to-day ledger work with utility analysis, and the temp to perm route gives you the chance to settle in, make your mark and secure a permanent place in the team.

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate will have:
- Previous purchase ledger or accounts payable experience would be a real advantage, but it isn't essential. The role is pitched at a level that suits someone looking to build their experience, so we'd love to hear from candidates keen to learn and grow
- Experience dealing with supplier queries and reconciling supplier statements is desirable but not essential
- Good Excel skills and confidence using an accounting system
- A sound understanding of VAT on purchase invoices
- A high level of accuracy and attention to detail, with the ability to prioritise around payment deadlines
- Clear, polite communication skills on the phone and by email
- Experience checking or reconciling utility bills is desirable but not essential

Why Join the business
- Hybrid working
- Salary of £26,000 - £28,000
- Temp to perm with a clear route to a permanent role
- Stable, well-established organisation
- Varied role spanning purchase ledger, supplier queries and utilities
- Close-knit, supportive finance team

About Us

We are a local accountancy recruitment specialist. We appreciate that roles are often online for a long period of time. If you want to check if this role is still live or just want more details before applying, call us directly.

title: Receptionist
description: We are looking for an enthusiastic, friendly and professional person to join our reception team! Marysville Medical Practice has a population list size of 6500, and is based in the Belle Vue area of Shrewsbury, in a modern, spacious building. Receptionists play a vital role in general practice; they are the first line of contact for all patients and members of the public visiting and telephoning the practice so first impressions are very important. You would be joining our supportive and friendly practice, providing a high standard of care to our patient population. Although experience of primary care is beneficial we are also interested in those with transferable skills. Good communication skills and a friendly but professional "can do" attitude is essential. We would be flexible for the right candidate but are looking for someone to join us on a full time basis, permanent contract. For more details and an informal discussion please contact Izzy.Culliss@nhs.net Reception Duties: Ensure efficiency of the EMIS computerized appointment system and monitor the flow of patients into consulting rooms. Ensure that patients without appointments but who need to see a doctor urgently are seen in a logical and non-disruptive manner. Respond to all requests for assistance and information from patients and other visitors Ensure all requests for prescriptions are actioned as per practice policy Ensure that all shared areas of the building are kept neat and tidy Management of EMIS Appointment Systems: Book appointments ensuring sufficient information is recorded to retrieve medical records Management of Medical Records: Retrieve and file records Ensure correspondence e.g. Reports, hospital letters, results are properly scanned and then filed accurately and in the correct order Operation of Telephone System: Receive calls, make calls, divert calls and take accurate messages as required. PURPOSE OF POST: To provide a point of contact for patients and act as a focal point of communication between patients, doctors, the Primary Health Care Team and the administration staff. Responsible To: Practice Manager Major Duties and Responsibilities of the Post Reception Duties Management of EMIS Appointment Systems Management of Medical Records Operation of Telephone System Start and End of Day Procedures Specialist tasks once proficient at the basic level e.g. 1) Preparation of specialist reports including tracking payment and dispatch or reports by Recorded delivery 2) Implementing the Childhood Immunisation recall system. 3) Receiving and dispatching medical records as patients join, leave or die, this includes use of the GP2GP electronic system 4) Carrying out medical audit under GPs direction 5) Assembling and dispatching FP10s and associated Annexes to the Prescriptions Pricing Authority. 7) Recall of patients in chronic Disease management 8) Recording of cytology results and administrative duties within this area 9) Co-ordination of vasectomy clinics and all administrative duties associated with this Any other delegated duties considered appropriate to the post Special Requirements of the Post: An understanding, acceptance and adherence to the need for strict confidentiality as failure to do so will result in dismissal An ability to use own judgment, resourcefulness, common sense to respond to patients non clinical inquiries and requests Excellent communication skills Accuracy in transcribing information Ability to work without supervision and determine own workload priorities Keyboard skills and computer literacy skills desirable Ability to work well within a team and under pressure Ability to be flexible within the working week if needed, and to be prepared to work some early mornings/evenings and weekends as and when required
